retrievalProfile.description: A DIY collage style that combines high-contrast monochrome photography with vibrant, hand-painted primary colors and geometric folk borders.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central black-and-white photograph of a man and an animal integrated into a vibrant, hand-painted environment featuring a saturated yellow sky and vertical zigzag borders in primary colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject against a highly saturated yellow background
Symmetrical vertical borders framing a central square composition
Hand-drawn, blocky typography contained within a secondary color block
Texture contrast between grainy film photography and thick paint strokes
coreInvariants: Vertical zigzag borders on left and right edges
High-contrast black and white central photography
Saturated yellow upper background with visible brushwork

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man and a ram occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The ram's face and horns serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the high-contrast monochrome subject up to the vibrant yellow sky and then to the decorative side borders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with texture, patterns, and color.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red, green, and blue (zigzag borders and text box)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between the desaturated subject and the maximum-saturation surrounding elements.

letterConstructionRules: Hand-drawn with visible ink bleed and shaky outlines
Varying stroke widths within individual characters
Letters are tightly packed and slightly overlapping
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a high crossbar and wide stance
The 'M' has deep, sharp valleys reaching the baseline

treatment.fill: Yellow with red/blue chromatic aberration effect

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display word paired with geometric borders.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar heavy weight and playful proportions
Captures the irregular, tactile feel of the original lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a man with a sheep in a rustic farm setting. Mask the top third of the image and replace it with a hand-painted, textured yellow background. Add vertical borders on the left and right featuring a multi-colored zigzag pattern (red, green, yellow, blue).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Create a blue rectangular box in the top left. Inside, hand-draw a single bold word in yellow with irregular black outlines and slight red/blue offset effects.

verificationChecks: Is the central photo strictly monochrome?
Are the zigzag borders symmetrical on both sides?
Does the yellow background show visible brush strokes?
Is the text contained within a distinct color block?

adjustableVariables: Background color (yellow can be swapped for orange or cyan)
mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific likeness of the person in the photo
Do not replicate the specific word 'RAM'
postGenerationChecks: Check for visible paint texture in the yellow areas
Ensure the zigzag pattern is hand-drawn, not perfectly geometric
Verify the text looks like it was drawn with a marker
Confirm the photo has a grainy, film-like quality
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Subject + Saturated Hand-Painted Sky + Zigzag Folk Borders + Blocky Hand-Lettered Display Text
